paragraphs: Friend, look at how much human mess is packed into this passage. Abner is furious, Ish-bosheth is too afraid to say another word (2 Samuel 3:11), and David is setting his terms at the door. Yet when Abner talks, he points to "what the LORD has sworn" to David (2 Samuel 3:9). The moods go up and down like a batch in a bad oven, and God's word just sits there, steady.

That matters for YOU, because your week has mess in it too. Tense conversations, plans that fall apart, people who change their minds. Later Abner tells the elders, "the LORD has said to David…" (2 Samuel 3:18), and what God has said is the part that doesn't wobble. His promises don't wait for everybody around you to behave.

So here's the big idea, baker. Build on what God has said, not on how people feel today. I can't even keep my own timer straight, and His word doesn't need me to. And this story isn't over, friend, so keep your oven mitts handy.
